name: ember
_note: Warm terracotta/amber — campfire-at-the-park. Accent rides ~H19 (designer terracotta #b34e1e light, glowing coral #e8875a dark — console-remake accepted ramp); the neutral ladder and paper ground re-hue warm off the accent, so paper/ink visibly carry heat, never grey. The dark amber accent is the on-accent flip's live test (bright fill → near-ink text).

_overrideReasons.reading-accent.light: formula rotates the H20 accent −40° to HSL340 (a hot rose-pink) — off-temperature for a warm family; pinned to a warm brick-red rust sibling (code.fg.light tracks this, so it warms too)
_overrideReasons.reading-accent.dark: formula's HSL350 is a cool pink; pinned to a bright warm coral so the dark reading/code accent stays in the ember family
_overrideReasons.surface.dark: the neutral-ladder OKLCH L0.095 pick collapses to ~1% HSL-L — a crushed pure-black that loses the warm tint; pinned to a designed warm near-black that grounds the page under bg (8%) and holds the campfire temperature
